    Log-scale SD and location of the edgeR smoothed-dispersion prior

    Source: R/dispersion_prior.R
    estimate_dispersion_prior-methods.Rd

    Writes two rowData columns from the shared log-likelihood grid: dispersion_prior_log_mean is trended.dispersion (\(\phi_{\mathrm{trend}}\)), and dispersion_prior_log_sd is a width on \(\log(\phi)\). method = "curvature" (default) fills that width with the local Normal (Laplace) approximation of the weighted smoothed shared log-likelihood; method = "degrees_freedom" fills it with \(\sqrt{\psi'(d_{\mathrm{eff}}/2)}\) from the moderated df \(d_{\mathrm{residual}} + d_0\). \(d_0\) is squeezeVar()'s df.prior, the same empirical-Bayes prior df that estimateDisp() returns as prior.df. Pass both column names to estimate_gene() / estimate() as dispersion_prior_log_mean and dispersion_prior_log_sd. See vignette("dispersion-priors").

    estimate_dispersion_prior(
  .data,
  formula_abundance,
  abundance = "counts",
  method = c("curvature", "degrees_freedom"),
  log_sd_column = "dispersion_prior_log_sd",
  mean_column = "dispersion_prior_log_mean",
  n_local = 10L,
  grid.range = c(-20, 10),
  grid.length = 61L
)

# S4 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
estimate_dispersion_prior(
  .data,
  formula_abundance,
  abundance = "counts",
  method = c("curvature", "degrees_freedom"),
  log_sd_column = "dispersion_prior_log_sd",
  mean_column = "dispersion_prior_log_mean",
  n_local = 10L,
  grid.range = c(-20, 10),
  grid.length = 61L
)

# S4 method for class 'RangedSummarizedExperiment'
estimate_dispersion_prior(
  .data,
  formula_abundance,
  abundance = "counts",
  method = c("curvature", "degrees_freedom"),
  log_sd_column = "dispersion_prior_log_sd",
  mean_column = "dispersion_prior_log_mean",
  n_local = 10L,
  grid.range = c(-20, 10),
  grid.length = 61L
)

    Arguments

    .data

    A SummarizedExperiment with counts in abundance.

    formula_abundance

    Fixed-effect model for the mean, used to build the edgeR design. edgeR has no random effects, so write the analogue yourself (~ dex + cell for ~ dex + (1 | cell)). A | in the formula is an error.

    abundance

    Assay name holding integer counts. Default "counts".

    method

    "curvature" (default) or "degrees_freedom". Chooses how log_sd_column is filled.

    log_sd_column

    Name of the rowData column to write for the log-scale SD. Default "dispersion_prior_log_sd". Pass this name to estimate_gene() / estimate() as dispersion_prior_log_sd.

    mean_column

    Name of the rowData column to write for the prior location, trended.dispersion (\(\phi_{\mathrm{trend}}\)). Default "dispersion_prior_log_mean". Pass this name to estimate_gene() / estimate() as dispersion_prior_log_mean.

    n_local

    Number of dispersion-grid points used in the local quadratic around each gene's trended dispersion. Used when method = "curvature". Default 10.

    grid.range

    Range of the dispersion grid in spline.pts units, where phi = 0.1 * 2^spline.pts. Default c(-20, 10).

    grid.length

    Number of points on that grid. Default 61.

    Value

    .data with mean_column and log_sd_column added to rowData. The mean is the trended \(\phi\). The SD is the Laplace width on \(\log(\phi)\) when method = "curvature" (NA where the quadratic cannot be formed), or the trigamma SD from the moderated df when method = "degrees_freedom".

    Details

    estimateDisp() does not return the shared log-likelihood grid, so this rebuilds it (the same Cox–Reid profile-likelihood grid and WLEB() smooth that estimateDisp() uses) and, for "curvature", fits a local quadratic around log(trended.dispersion).
